claim.claim-text: 1. A method used by a wireless transmit/receive unit, WTRU, (102) for wireless communications, the method comprising:

2. The method of claim 1, further comprising: on condition that UL data associated with an LCH or a radio bearer not among the indicated one or more LCHs or radio bearers becomes available for transmission, transmitting, in the RRC inactive state, the identity of the WTRU and an RRC message to request to transition back to the RRC connected state.

3. The method of claim 1, further comprising: on condition that the UL data associated with the indicated one or more LCHs or radio bearers becomes available for transmission and the UL data does not satisfy the one or more criteria for transmission while in the RRC inactive state, transmitting, in the RRC inactive state, the identity of the WTRU and an RRC message to request to transition back to the RRC connected state.

4. The method of claim 1, further comprising: on condition that the UL data associated with the indicated one or more LCHs or radio bearers becomes available for transmission and a portion of the UL data satisfies the one or more criteria for transmission while in the RRC inactive state, transmitting, in the RRC inactive state, the portion of the UL data, the identity of the WTRU, and an RRC message to request to transition back to the RRC connected state.
5. The method of claim 1, wherein the one or more criteria for transmission further comprise any of:
6. The method of claim 1, further comprising: performing extended monitoring of a control channel for a predetermined duration after the UL data is transmitted in the RRC inactive state.
7. The method of claim 1, wherein an active context for the WTRU or the context information is maintained during the RRC inactive state.

8. The method of claim 7, wherein the active context or the context information includes any of: the identity of the WTRU, one or more measurement configurations, one or more measurement triggers, one or more access tables, and one or more Radio Access Network paging areas.
9. The method of claim 1, further comprising:

10. The method of claim 9, wherein first and second sets of resources are used to communicate with the first and second TRPs, respectively, and wherein the first and second TRPs are associated with first and second radio access technologies respectively.
11. The method of claim 9, further comprising communicating with the second TRP in the RRC connected state.
12. The method of claim 9, wherein the condition comprises any of:
13. A wireless transmit/receive unit, WTRU, comprising circuitry, including a receiver, a transmitter, a processor, and memory, configured to perform the method of any one of claims 1-12.
14. A computer-readable storage medium containing instructions which when executed by a computer cause the computer to carry out the method of any one of claims 1-12.
